A motor owned by an active platform is rejected with MOTOR_OWNED; use COAST_PLATFORM or STOP_PLATFORM_CONTROLLER for platform wheels. On dual-PWM boards both PWM control inputs are high. On V4 enable/direction boards DISABLE is low and EN duty is zero; direction does not affect braking. The command ID and payload are the same for all boards; firmware selects the hardware behavior from the board configuration. Short braking does not regulate or hold a specific position. A motor owned by an active platform is rejected with MOTOR_OWNED; use BRAKE_PLATFORM for platform wheels. Re-initialize the motor controller before using target-speed control again. commands.description: This command sets the global update frequency (in Hz) of the closed-loop motor controller task. All motor controllers share a single control loop, so this frequency is global and affects every currently running controller as well as any created afterwards; the PID sampling time is updated to match. The requested value is clamped to the supported range of 1 to 1000 Hz (the 1000 Hz maximum is bounded by the 1 ms RTOS tick). The value is then quantized to the 1 ms RTOS tick (period_ms = 1000 / frequency), so effective frequencies are 1000/N Hz. A value of 0 is invalid and ignored. Defaults to 10 Hz (100 ms) at start-up.

properties.description: The controller update frequency in Hz. Valid range 1 to 1000 Hz; values outside are clamped, and 0 is ignored.

commands.description: Set the board-wide motor inhibit. Entry stops all controllers and blocks new motion. On v0.3 and Nano (protocol 2.17), entry holds each DRV8870 input pair low. Release keeps the inputs low until a fresh drive or explicit short brake. On v0.4 (protocol 2.15+), wake verifies retained settings for initialized drivers and leaves outputs stopped. Failed transitions retain the inhibit for explicit retry. Requires READY and a profile supporting driver sleep.

commands.description: Set communication-preserving board idle. Entry (1) stops control, inhibits the drivers and permits shallow CPU sleep between tasks. USB traffic, time sync, queries and heartbeat keep using the existing session. Only explicit exit (0) clears idle. Exit preserves a prior independent driver inhibit and leaves outputs stopped. On original v0.3 and Nano both DRV8870 inputs stay low until fresh drive or brake. On v0.4, previously active drivers are verified before release. A failed transition retains idle and inhibit for explicit retry. Requires READY, an idle-capable profile and protocol 2.18 on v0.3 or Nano, or 2.16 on v0.4.

commands.description: Read the shared logical idle request without clearing it. Interrupts can resume the CPU while this request remains set. GET_DRIVER_SLEEP reports the effective driver inhibit. Idle survives reconnect and clears at reset. Requires READY and board idle support (original v0.3 and Nano since protocol 2.18, v0.4 since 2.16).

commands.description: Configure the volatile v0.4 experiment only while motion is stopped and all commanded targets and motor outputs are zero; initialized controllers with idle zero targets are allowed. Mode 0 retains the legacy encoder path (boot default), 1 uses encoder feedback with the common chassis correction, and 2 uses fused feedback with that same correction. No IMU-only mode. For modes 1/2 the caller declares a rigid, level board with component side up, IMU at the chassis reference point, and mounting_yaw_rad as the angle of board +X expressed in chassis XY, counterclockwise about chassis +Z. Sensor-to-board axes are (-x,-y,+z); chassis axes are forward/left/up. Reject nonfinite or out-of-range yaw, any observed configured encoder movement in the preceding 100 ms, or a counter change since a fresh sample. Stopped cold setup may ACK in WAITING; ACK does not establish readiness. Both experimental modes require 100 ms of observed unchanged configured counters for initial rest arming before accepting a motion target; once armed, ordinary target updates remain accepted while moving; fused bias calibration may run within that window. Reconfiguration cancels old targets. Sources may requalify automatically after an ordinary sensor fault, but healthy inputs and a fresh target are required before control resumes. Does not save to FRAM or start motion. Requires READY, exact v0.4.0 fusion capability and protocol 2.19.

properties.name: mounting_yaw_rad
properties.description: Declared level centered mounting yaw in radians.

commands.description: Read experiment mode, health, fault, flags and timestamped sample ages without setting targets or changing configuration. A read may enforce an expired feedback deadline, clear the live target and coast. Health/fault/flag values use the FusionHealth/FusionFault/FusionFlag catalogs. Timestamp uses the monotonic board clock; unavailable ages are UINT32_MAX. The physical IMU producer waits 2 ms between passes, without guaranteeing a 2 ms acquisition cadence, and pairs only acquisition windows entirely preceding the encoder timestamp: each window is at most 5 ms wide, worst-case accel/gyro skew at most 15 ms, and age at most 35 ms. These are software acceptance limits, not a physical timing qualification. ESTIMATE_VALID describes the selected experiment estimate, not physical accuracy. Requires READY, exact v0.4.0 fusion capability and protocol 2.19.

response.name: fusion_status
response.description: Packed little-endian diagnostic snapshot.

commands.description: Read one compact experiment vector: 0 encoder pose (relative x,y,yaw), 1 encoder body twist (vx,vy,yaw rate), 2 fused pose, 3 fused body twist, 4 estimated bias (ax,ay,gyro z). Units are metres, seconds and radians. On outage recovery, the last fused-from-encoder world transform is reapplied to the current encoder pose. Returns SAMPLE_NOT_AVAILABLE when the requested estimate is invalid. Match sequence with GET_FUSION_STATUS to associate timestamp/health; different sequences are different snapshots. At most 28 payload bytes so the framed reply fits Arduino Wire32. Does not reset state or start motion. Requires READY, exact v0.4.0 fusion capability and protocol 2.19.

commands.description: Control volatile IMU-only relative tracking. START=0, RESET=2 and RECALIBRATE=3 are accepted from any state with stationary_mount_confirmed=1 and finite yaw in [-pi,pi]; all discard prior bias and pose and begin full cold stationary calibration at a new relative origin. The caller confirms true zero velocity, rigid level sensor-+Z-up mounting with IMU at the chassis reference point. Yaw is the angle of sensor +X in chassis XY, counterclockwise about chassis +Z. Sensor-to-chassis transform is Rz(yaw)*(x,y,z), axes forward/left/up. IMU stationarity checks cannot establish zero constant velocity. STOP=1 requires confirmation=0 and yaw=0 and stops integration. ACK confirms the action, not a valid estimate. Fault, expiry or interruption requires deliberate restart; no automatic recovery. Not saved to FRAM. Requires READY, exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with imu_tracking capability and protocol 2.20+. Independent of platform, encoders and fusion; never commands motion or changes control feedback.

properties.description: ImuTrackingAction value.

properties.name: stationary_mount_confirmed
properties.description: Explicit caller confirmation of stationary zero velocity and the supported rigid level centered mount; 0 or 1.

properties.name: mounting_yaw_rad
properties.description: Angle of sensor +X in chassis XY, counterclockwise about chassis +Z; sensor +Z up. Finite radians.

commands.description: Read IMU-only tracking state, fault, flags, sequence, last eligible joint sample-watermark timestamp, wall elapsed time since the source origin capped at window_us and separate accel/gyro ages in microseconds. UINT32_MAX age means unavailable. ESTIMATE_VALID is required for usable current estimates; timestamp and health are not physical accuracy guarantees. A delayed in-window source sample may remain readable briefly after the wall clock reaches the source end. Healthy tracking expires upon the first consumed source watermark at or beyond the end, or by the first serviced status/vector/configuration read at or after end + 50000 us. Missing, stale or invalid input may fault earlier. This is a serviced-read guarantee, not a hard real-time scheduling guarantee. Reads never start tracking. Status and vector sequences must match to combine separate reads. Requires READY, exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with imu_tracking capability and protocol 2.20+. Independent of platform, encoders and fusion; never commands motion or changes control feedback.

response.name: imu_tracking_status
response.description: Packed little-endian IMU-only tracking snapshot.

commands.description: Read a compact IMU-only vector selected by kind: POSE=0 (relative metres,metres,radians), TWIST=1 (body metres/second,metres/second,radians/second), BIAS=2 (accel-X,accel-Y metres/second squared and gyro-Z radians/second). SAMPLE_NOT_AVAILABLE means the requested estimate is invalid. Match sequence with GET_IMU_TRACKING_STATUS; never combine mismatched snapshots. Relative integration drifts and has no absolute position or heading reference. Requires READY, exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with imu_tracking capability and protocol 2.20+. Independent of platform, encoders and fusion; never commands motion or changes control feedback.

commands.description: Read mounting yaw and the actual bounded tracking horizon in microseconds. This v0.4 release reports 1000000 us for a one-second motion-onset diagnostic. Always use readback for the connected board horizon. The eligible source interval is [origin, origin + window_us); at 100 Hz it contains 100 source stamps including origin and excluding the end. No estimate at or beyond the source end is published. Reset clears volatile tracking state; reconnect does not start or re-anchor tracking. Requires READY, exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with imu_tracking capability and protocol 2.20+. Independent of platform, encoders and fusion; never commands motion or changes control feedback.

commands.description: Choose the board-wide telemetry preference. A change requires stopped outputs, disarmed controllers and stationary observed encoders. An unchanged preference is idempotent. The selector never starts motion, wheel odometry, standalone IMU calibration or a controller. FUSED uses an independent passive instance of the release estimator when its explicit mount and encoder odometry are available. It anchors a new relative frame at the first available source sample serviced after a switch or producer restart. The existing SAVE_CONFIGURATION explicitly persists the preference alongside platform setup; cold restore never restores an origin, bias, stationary declaration or motion target. Requires READY and exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with feedback_source_selector and protocol 2.21 or newer. Selection only routes tracking telemetry.

commands.description: Get requested and active source, availability reason and producer detail. Invalid status reports active NONE; no fallback. While valid the sample sequence and monotonic timestamp identify the underlying producer publication. Inspect requested source diagnostics for acquisition ages and fault detail. The standalone IMU is a one-second relative motion-onset diagnostic; fused telemetry uses the existing experimental estimator. Reconnect reads live board state. Requires READY and exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with feedback_source_selector and protocol 2.21 or newer. Selection only routes tracking telemetry.

response.description: Packed little-endian selector readback.

commands.description: Get selector-relative pose (metres, metres, unwrapped radians) or body twist (metres/second, metres/second, radians/second), +X forward, +Y left, yaw CCW. Relative XY is rotated into the heading at the new anchor. First capture a valid status, then request both vectors with its exact origin_id and sequence. Eight distinct recent captures are retained for at most 50000 us after capture. Both keys and the current healthy source/frame must match. Selected historical sample age cannot exceed 50000 us for IMU-only, 60000 us for fused, or three configured encoder periods. Expiry or invalidation immediately rejects cached data. A final live status may naturally advance sequence and time; require the same valid requested/active source and origin, match both vector sequences to the original capture and retry on SAMPLE_NOT_AVAILABLE. Compare origins only within the same boot. Requires READY and exact model 1 hardware 0.4.0 with feedback_source_selector and protocol 2.21 or newer. Selection only routes tracking telemetry.

commands.description: Read producer health independently of selector and control. objects.name: feedback_fusion_mount
objects.description: Passive tracking mount, independent of chassis control.

properties.name: confirmed
properties.description: One after an explicit mount declaration this boot.

properties.name: mounting_yaw_rad
properties.description: Angle of board +X in chassis XY, counterclockwise about +Z in radians. Rigid, level, centered board with +Z up.

objects.name: feedback_source_health
objects.description: Read producer health independently of selector and control. ENCODER is the running platform encoder batch, IMU_ONLY is physical BMI088 pair availability independent of the one-second estimate, FUSED is the passive fused estimate. Disagreement indicates conflicting observations without assigning sensor blame. HEALTHY means directly usable data. Comparability is separate. Historical provenance remains readable during failure. Reconnect reads board state.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Echo of FeedbackSource request.

properties.name: health
properties.description: FeedbackSourceHealthState.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: FeedbackSourceReason for current producer availability.

properties.name: detail
properties.description: FusionFault explanation if present.

properties.name: flags
properties.description: FeedbackSourceHealthFlag bit mask.

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: Sequence of the last producer publication or observed distinct raw IMU pair, wrapping modulo 2^32; use PROVENANCE for presence.

properties.name: timestamp_us
properties.description: Last usable source time in board uptime microseconds. For the BMI088 pair this is its older die timestamp.

properties.name: age_us
properties.description: Age of that timestamp in board uptime microseconds, UINT32_MAX if absent, future or too old to represent.

properties.name: max_age_us
properties.description: Source freshness budget in microseconds.

objects.name: feedback_imu_channels
objects.description: Read independent last observed accelerometer and gyro acquisition times in board uptime microseconds. A timestamp of zero and age UINT32_MAX indicate no observed acquisition. These are physical source observations, independent of the finite IMU-only tracking window. A pair must meet the 35000 us age and 15000 us skew limits.

properties.name: accel_timestamp_us
properties.description: Last observed accelerometer acquisition time in board uptime microseconds.

properties.name: gyro_timestamp_us
properties.description: Last observed gyro acquisition time in board uptime microseconds.

properties.name: accel_age_us
properties.description: Board-derived acquisition age in microseconds, UINT32_MAX if unknown.

properties.name: gyro_age_us
properties.description: Board-derived acquisition age in microseconds, UINT32_MAX if unknown.

header.description: Shared header. Length counts subsequent bytes. Message IDs increment from 1 through 65535 then wrap to 1; 0 is reserved for unsolicited messages or errors lacking an ID. Replies and errors echo the initiating request ID. Senders must skip outstanding IDs.

error_codes.name: INCOMPATIBLE_PROTOCOL
error_codes.description: The requested protocol version is incompatible with this firmware.

error_codes.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
error_codes.description: A field is invalid, out of range, or inconsistent with the pending request.

error_codes.name: UNKNOWN_COMMAND
error_codes.description: The received command ID is not accepted by the controller.

error_codes.name: INVALID_LENGTH
error_codes.description: The complete message has an invalid header or payload length.

error_codes.name: MOTOR_OWNED
error_codes.description: The motor belongs to a platform; use the corresponding platform command.

error_codes.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
error_codes.description: The controller could not execute or encode the operation. During motor initialization, possible causes include missing motor power, a driver communication failure, or a faulty driver.

error_codes.name: CLOCK_NOT_READY
error_codes.description: Initial clock setup is incomplete; wait for READY. Uptime mode also supports READY.

error_codes.name: TIME_SYNC_FAILED
error_codes.description: Initial time sync exhausted its attempts without a valid sample.

error_codes.name: ODOMETRY_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Odometry is not running; start odometry before requesting a measurement.

error_codes.name: SAMPLE_NOT_AVAILABLE
error_codes.description: The requested measurement is not ready yet, including after initialization or reset; retry after an update.

error_codes.name: ENCODER_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Initialize the encoder before reading it or starting encoder odometry.

error_codes.name: PLATFORM_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Initialize a platform before performing this operation.

error_codes.name: MOTOR_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Initialize the motor before setting its speed.

error_codes.name: CONTROLLER_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Start or initialize the closed-loop controller before setting its target.

error_codes.name: INIT_REQUIRED
error_codes.description: Send a valid INIT request before performing this connection-dependent operation.

error_codes.name: SENSOR_NOT_AVAILABLE
error_codes.description: The selected sensor is not defined on this board.

error_codes.name: SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT
error_codes.description: This connection has no free subscription slots; unsubscribe an existing source first.

error_codes.name: SAMPLE_OUT_OF_RANGE
error_codes.description: The sensor reading is saturated; no valid measurement can be returned.

error_codes.name: DRIVERS_ASLEEP
error_codes.description: Driver sleep is active. Explicitly wake the drivers before requesting this operation.

error_codes.name: BOARD_IDLE
error_codes.description: Board idle is active. Explicitly wake the board before changing driver sleep or starting a subscription.

error_codes.name: SOURCE_SWITCH_UNSAFE
error_codes.description: Stop all motor outputs, disarm all controllers and wait for stationary wheel observations before changing the tracking preference.

subscription_modes.name: PERIODIC
subscription_modes.description: Send the latest sample at each interval.

subscription_modes.name: ON_CHANGE
subscription_modes.description: Send an initial sample, then changed values. Check values at each interval; exclude timestamp and clock metadata from comparison.

subscription_triggers.name: ON_EVENT
subscription_triggers.description: Read promptly on a source event, with background diagnostic reconciliation.

subscription_deliveries.name: ON_CHANGE
subscription_deliveries.description: Send changed values and optional maximum-silence refreshes.

feedback_source_reasons.name: MOUNT_REQUIRED
feedback_source_reasons.description: Declare a rigid level centered mount for passive fused tracking.
